review_basis: 0.0.7 source 07f7e8d vs metric v2; CHANGED_METRICS exclusion plus D-055 curvature exclusion. Explicit conservative allowlist, not the complement of CHANGED_METRICS.

allowlist.avg_speed: Mean recorded robot velocity magnitude; no terminal-goal or SNQI dependence; formula unchanged.
allowlist.energy: Sum of recorded acceleration magnitudes (proxy, not physical energy); formula unchanged.
allowlist.clearing_distance_min: Minimum trajectory-to-obstacle distance in metres; formula unchanged; absent obstacles remain missing.
allowlist.clearing_distance_avg: Mean nearest-obstacle distance in metres; formula unchanged; absent obstacles remain missing.
allowlist.near_misses: Count of pedestrian distances within fixed near-miss threshold; formula unchanged.

additional_changed.curvature_mean: D-055: conservatively version-qualified; never subtract even though absent from CHANGED_METRICS.

excluded: Unreviewed fields, force-dependent comfort, terminal-goal-dependent fields and SNQI dependencies are never admitted to the allowlist. robot_force_* and snqi_v2* are successor-only.
